menubar.title: Menu bar
menubar.description: Open, save, share and export your project, create new programs (grafcet, ladder) and find the manual, the training modules and the keyboard shortcuts.

explorer.title: Explorer
explorer.description: The variables, programs and HMI pages of the project. Right-click opens an action menu.

pages.title: Workspace
pages.description: Editors open here, in tabs: grafcets, ladders, variables and HMI pages.

hmiPages.title: HMI pages
hmiPages.description: Draw an animated operator interface linked to the project variables. Right-click this folder to create a page.

simulation.title: Analysis and simulation
simulation.description: Analyse the project, then switch to simulation mode to run it: start, stop or step through it.

crossReference.title: Cross-references
crossReference.description: For each variable, see which programs read it and which write it.

analysis.title: Analysis results
analysis.description: The errors and warnings found in the project. Click to see the details; the colour shows the severity.
